description: The transcripts of BibleTTS. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are BibleTTS's per-verse text files, inside archives that total about 90 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
